$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F06 side (A3) from the wearer's right, a little from behind. The lens is seen edge-on here: what shows through the frame is handled as a gap. The engraved wordmark and the old emblem after it come off the near temple. The temple's edges hardly converge, so the GCD is placed with the old print as a ruler: its ends lie 26.3 and 41.4 mm from the hinge (measured in the 3D model on the hero, IMG_3483).

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old emblem, near temple (inset from the temple's edges)
